package private

import (
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/private/middleware"
)

// NewRouter builds private health routes protected by the internal token.
func NewRouter(health *handlers.HealthHandler, internalToken string) chi.Router {
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Use(middleware.RequireInternalToken(internalToken))
	router.Get("/healthz", health.Healthz)
	router.Get("/readyz", health.Readyz)
	return router
}
